getIdentityRegistry().details: Interface completeness: cross-link back to the identity registry.

getSummary(uint256,address[],string,stri.details: Faithful average: sum(value * 10^(18 - decimals)) in WAD, then      summaryValue = (sum / count) / 10^(18 - modeDecimals), returned      at the mode decimals. Integer truncation matches the reference.

appendResponse(uint256,uint64,address,st.notice: Append a response URI/hash to an existing feedback entry.         Unused by BULWARK v1 (kept for interface fidelity).

getClients(uint256).notice: All client addresses that ever gave feedback to an agent.

getLastIndex(uint256,address).notice: Latest feedback index used by a client (0 = none).

giveFeedback(uint256,int128,uint8,string.notice: Give feedback on an agent. `value` int128 with         `valueDecimals` 0..18, |value| <= 1e38. Per (agentId, client)         feedback is 1-indexed and append-only (revoke, never edit).

readAllFeedback(uint256,address[],string.notice: All matching, non-revoked feedback entries. Empty         `clientAddresses` = every client that ever gave feedback to         this agent (on the reference; Arc v2.0.0 matches).

readFeedback(uint256,address,uint64).notice: One feedback entry; reverts for index 0 / out of bounds.

revokeFeedback(uint256,uint64).notice: Revoke one of YOUR feedback entries by index (irreversible flag).
